info.title: Natural API
info.description:
Natural's payments API for autonomous agents.

**Base URL:** `https://api.natural.com`

AI agents, including coding agents, should prefer the hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.natural.com` when an MCP-aware host runs the agent, the Natural CLI for terminal/CI workflows, and the official SDKs for application runtimes they own. Use direct HTTP only for explicit low-level integrations, unsupported SDK gaps, or infrastructure work where REST is required.

For support: support@natural.com

post.description: Create a payment request

customerPartyId.description: Requester party ID (pty_*). Omit to request into your own wallet; provide for delegated payment requests on behalf of a customer.

walletId.description: Wallet (wal_*) that should receive the funds. Omit to use the requester party's default wallet.

description.description: Free-form description shown to the payer. Maximum 80 characters.

payerName.description: Display name of the payer. Maximum 32 characters.

payer.title: PaymentRequestPayer
payer.description: Who pays: exactly one typed email, phone, party ID, agent ID, or handle value.

status.description: Payment request status.

description.description: Free-form description provided at creation. Maximum 80 characters.

requesterName.description: Display name of the party requesting payment.

requesterEmail.description: Email of the party requesting payment.

requesterAvatarUrl.description: Public avatar URL for the party requesting payment, if one is set.

requesterHandle.description: The requesting party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when it has none.

walletName.description: Receiving wallet name, or null when unnamed or hidden from the caller.

payerEmail.description: Email of the payer, or null when none is known.

payerAvatarUrl.description: Public avatar URL for the payer party, if one is set.

payerHandle.description: The resolved payer party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when off-platform or handle-less.

payerPhone.description: Payer phone number when addressed by phone.

payerPartyId.description: Natural party ID (pty_*) resolved for the payer, including agent owner parties.

payerIdentifierType.description: Identifier type used to address the payer.

payerIdentifier.description: Identifier value used to address the payer.

handle.description: The initiating party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when it has none.

initiatorParty.description: The party that created this payment request, or null when unresolved. When an agent created it, this is the agent's owning party.

handle.description: The agent's composed public handle (@namespace-slug), or null when it has none.

initiatorAgent.description: Agent that created this payment request, when one did. Otherwise null.

paymentLinkUrl.description: URL the payer visits to complete payment.

transactionId.description: ID of the transaction created by the most recent payment attempt, or null if no attempt yet.

createdAt.description: When the payment request was created.

updatedAt.description: When the payment request was last updated.

payerParty.title: NullableToOneRelationship
payerParty.description: Resolved payer party, if the payer is known to Natural.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for safely retrying a request without creating duplicates.

parameters.name: X-Agent-ID
parameters.description: Agent (agt_*) to attribute this request to when authenticating with a party API key; omit for agent keys and agent-scoped OAuth grants, which already carry agent identity.

parameters.name: X-Instance-ID
parameters.description: Caller-chosen identifier for the agent run, session, or conversation, required when an agent moves money.

status.description: Payment request status.

description.description: Free-form description provided at creation. Maximum 80 characters.

requesterName.description: Display name of the party requesting payment.

requesterEmail.description: Email of the party requesting payment.

requesterAvatarUrl.description: Public avatar URL for the party requesting payment, if one is set.

requesterHandle.description: The requesting party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when it has none.

walletName.description: Receiving wallet name, or null when unnamed or hidden from the caller.

payerEmail.description: Email of the payer, or null when none is known.

payerAvatarUrl.description: Public avatar URL for the payer party, if one is set.

payerHandle.description: The resolved payer party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when off-platform or handle-less.

payerPhone.description: Payer phone number when addressed by phone.

payerPartyId.description: Natural party ID (pty_*) resolved for the payer, including agent owner parties.

payerIdentifierType.description: Identifier type used to address the payer.

payerIdentifier.description: Identifier value used to address the payer.

handle.description: The initiating party's composed public handle (@namespace), or null when it has none.

initiatorParty.description: The party that created this payment request, or null when unresolved. When an agent created it, this is the agent's owning party.

handle.description: The agent's composed public handle (@namespace-slug), or null when it has none.

initiatorAgent.description: Agent that created this payment request, when one did. Otherwise null.

paymentLinkUrl.description: URL the payer visits to complete payment.

transactionId.description: ID of the transaction created by the most recent payment attempt, or null if no attempt yet.

createdAt.description: When the payment request was created.

updatedAt.description: When the payment request was last updated.

payerParty.title: NullableToOneRelationship
payerParty.description: Resolved payer party, if the payer is known to Natural.

payerAgent.title: NullableToOneRelationship
payerAgent.description: Payer agent, or null unless addressed by agent ID or agent handle.

payment.title: NullableToOneRelationship
payment.description: Payment submitted for this payment request, if one exists.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when rate limit resets.
